evidence.label: settlementPrice
evidence.query: query Explorer($channelId: String!) { settlementPrice(channelId: $channelId) { channelId  settledBlock  settledAt  settledBlockHash  agent  miner  escrow  minerPaid  burned  aggregateGn  unusedEscrow  pricePerGflop  cooperative  settlementKind  settlementEvent  marketKind  modelHash  gpuSku  assuranceTier  selfTrade  extrinsicHash  extrinsicIndex  eventIndex  callSection  callMethod  } }

notes: Escrow arithmetic uses a settlement price row when present. Open channels have no final split to check. Arithmetic does not prove inference or settlement finality.
